hooks.command: file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|json|md)$'; then npx oxfmt "$file_path"; fi
file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$'; then npx oxlint "$file_path"; fi
file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1; fi
file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(rs)$'; then rustfmt "$file_path"; fi
file_path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path') && if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.rs$'; then cargo check --message-format=short 2>&1; fi
